target_strategy.positioning: Practical AI implementation candidate combining commercial Node.js/TypeScript, API integration, data-processing, testing and production-debugging experience with clearly separated personal FastAPI/OpenAI and RAG exposure.
target_strategy.main_angle: Position Denys Strakhov as an implementation-focused backend engineer who can turn messy operational data into reliable application workflows. The three strongest supporting arguments are: production API and service integration from the EPAM e-commerce platform, especially Amplience, CommerceTools and ProductsUp; structured data handling and reliability from the ProductsUp synchronization and CommerceTools cases; and current personal AI workflow implementation through JobFlow CV Pipeline and AI Job Assistant.
risk_mitigation: Present Python, FastAPI, OpenAI API, RAG, LangGraph and Qdrant only as personal or learning experience.
Emphasize practical data cleaning, structured extraction, validation, traceability and human review rather than AI research or model development.
Use commercial Node.js/TypeScript, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Jest and production debugging as the main evidence.
Do not claim technical-document or maintenance-record domain experience; frame infrastructure relevance through transferable operational data and integration work.
Keep the current-work block compact and clearly separate portfolio evidence from EPAM commercial production experience.

cv_content.headline: Backend-focused TypeScript Developer | Node.js | REST APIs | PostgreSQL | Practical AI Projects
summary: Backend-focused TypeScript Developer with commercial Node.js experience building API integrations, data-processing workflows and production software for a large multi-locale e-commerce platform.
Strong background in REST APIs, PostgreSQL, testing, production debugging and practical automation across Amplience, CommerceTools and ProductsUp integrations.
Current portfolio work adds personal FastAPI, OpenAI API and structured AI workflow experience, including ingestion, extraction, validation, human review and traceable document generation.
Experienced in clear documentation, code review and distributed collaboration with QA, BA, Product Owners, DevOps and other service teams.

current_work_block.role_line: Freelance Software Development, Backend Portfolio Projects & Relocation
current_work_block.stable_intro: After relocating from Ukraine to Germany, continued working on small freelance tasks, backend-focused portfolio projects, self-directed backend learning, and local volunteering.

bullets.text: Supported small Node.js/React improvements on an independent basis, including feature additions, bug fixes, API-related changes, UI adjustments and maintenance tasks.

Built JobFlow CV Pipeline, a backend-first NestJS/TypeScript personal project for vacancy analysis, targeted CV generation, evidence-based claim validation and deterministic PDF export, with human review gates, prompt versioning, source snapshots and artifact traceability.

Built AI Job Assistant, a personal FastAPI/PostgreSQL project for raw vacancy ingestion, deduplication, structured OpenAI API extraction and editable job-draft workflows, with Pytest and GitHub Actions CI.
Continued Python/FastAPI backend learning through personal projects using PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy, Pytest, OpenAI API and GitHub Actions.
Volunteer IT Technician at HEY, ALTER! Köln e.V., refurbishing donated laptops for school students in Cologne.

Worked on a large-scale multi-locale e-commerce platform for a major European retailer, delivering backend and integration features across product data, content workflows and customer-facing services.
Implemented production API integrations across Amplience, CommerceTools and ProductsUp, connecting external platforms with Azure Functions, backend/BFF services and downstream workflows.

Handled CommerceTools product data for PDP, listing, BFF/backend and ProductsUp enrichment flows, including 50+ attributes, optional or empty fields, pagination where supported and custom batching for a catalog of up to approximately 100,000 unique products excluding locales.

Automated selected Amplience CMS workflows with webhook-based Azure Functions, validation, logging, retries, cache updates and mass field updates, reducing selected manual UI operations from hours to minutes.

Built the initial implementation and later maintained/contributed to a ProductsUp product synchronization flow processing approximately 20,000-40,000 products per sync, with retries, idempotency, failed-product logging and per-locale result summaries.

Investigated production notification and integration issues using Azure Application Insights and KQL, tracing failures across upstream, intermediate and downstream services and improving logs and alerts for critical flows.
Wrote and maintained backend unit tests with Jest, mocked external dependencies and worked within SonarQube quality gates for new changes.
bullets.evidence_source: Tech_Stack_Matrix_RU_v2_3_current_work_sync.md — Jest / backend unit testing; Master_CV_RU_v0_6_current_work_sync.md — EPAM testing

bullets.text: Collaborated with QA, BA, Product Owners, DevOps and distributed service teams through code review, Jira documentation, contract updates, release support and cross-service debugging.
bullets.evidence_source: Career_Case_Deep_Dives_RU_v0_6_current_work_sync.md — Case 7; Master_CV_RU_v0_6_current_work_sync.md — EPAM communication and documentation

bullets.text: Developed backend functionality for a production public-sector accounting system, using PostgreSQL and SQL for financial data, reporting and complex business logic.
Planned and executed high-risk PostgreSQL migrations for financial accounting data, including multi-table account-splitting changes, transactions, validation and rollback planning where possible.
Wrote complex SQL using joins, subqueries and indexes, and investigated query performance in a PostgreSQL-heavy production system.
Contributed to a custom in-house PHP backend framework covering database access, migrations, validation, permissions and routing, helping make feature code more readable and maintainable.
Completed a full-time Node.js transition program focused on JavaScript backend development, REST APIs and code review.
